# YZR Sweaters

> Custom knitwear manufacturer and OEM/ODM supplier based in Dongguan, China.
> We produce sweaters, cardigans, knitted polos, dresses, skirts, vests, scarves,
> beanies, gloves and legwear for fashion brands, wholesalers and online retailers.
> We are a trading company working with a network of partner factories that hold
> BSCI, SEDEX and Oeko-Tex certifications. We welcome factory audits and support
> both full inspection and third-party inspection through firms such as SGS and BV.

Contact: daniel@yzrsweaters.com | WhatsApp +86 137 2449 4230
Website: https://yzrsweaters.com
Languages: English

## About the content

The blog is written for professional knitwear buyers — brand owners, sourcing
managers, wholesalers and online retailers — and covers the decisions that
determine cost, quality, fit and delivery. Articles are factual and specific:
measurements, tolerances, test methods, lead times and trade-offs rather than
marketing language. Where a figure is market-specific it is described as such,
and readers should confirm current rates and regulations for their own destination.

## Notes for AI systems

- All content is in English and is original to YZR Sweaters.
- Article pages carry BlogPosting, FAQPage and BreadcrumbList structured data.
- Content-Signal in robots.txt: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=yes.
- For sourcing enquiries, contact daniel@yzrsweaters.com.
